spec.title: SPIN PONG
spec.oneLiner: Bend every return, charge the perfect shot, and reach seven points first.
mechanics: Use ARCADE.pong with winScore 7 and one-player CPU play; the player controls the left paddle and the CPU controls the right paddle.
UP/DOWN move the paddle; LEFT/RIGHT are movement aliases. Hold B for slower precision movement when lining up a contact.

Press A during the serve pause to launch the ball. During an active rally, holding A charges the next paddle return, reducing movement speed while held; release or contact converts it into a charged return.
Paddle contact position controls rebound angle, while paddle velocity adds decaying spin, making a moving edge hit the primary skillful action.
Normal returns gain 7 velocity; charged returns gain 25 velocity, with total ball speed capped at 255. Each paddle contact affects the ball once and uses swept collision substeps.
The ball bounces from the top and bottom court boundaries. Missing the ball awards one point to the opponent, resets to a readable serve pause, and flashes the scoring side.
The CPU serves automatically after its pause and uses finite reaction speed, observation delay, and aim error; begin at moderate difficulty so early rallies teach placement and charging.
Award 100 points per point, with no farming from repeated contacts. Display a bright charge/impact effect and a short camera-free court flash for charged hits.
At seven points, end the match and call the runtime win/game-over result; reset all points, ball state, charge state, and presentation effects on a new init.
spec.artDirection: 256x224 arcade court with a dark navy background, crisp cyan center line, bright white ball, and contrasting player-blue and CPU-orange paddles. Use the foundation's readable paddle and impact frames; show a subtle trailing arc and two-stage charge glow around the ball only during a charged return. Keep the ball and paddle silhouettes high contrast, with compact score markers in the runtime HUD and a brief full-court flash on a scored point. Reserve the playfield below the top 12-pixel HUD and never obscure the ball path.

preserve: Two opposing paddles and one ball in a bounded court
Points awarded when the opponent misses
change: Add satisfying spin from paddle movement and contact position
Add charged returns using the A button

controls.left: Move the paddle left/right as aliases for vertical movement; eligible during serve pause and rallies.
controls.right: Move the paddle left/right as aliases for vertical movement; eligible during serve pause and rallies.
controls.up: Move the player's paddle upward during serve pause and rallies.
controls.down: Move the player's paddle downward during serve pause and rallies.
controls.a: Press during the serve pause to serve; hold during a rally to charge the next return, with reduced paddle movement while held.
controls.b: Hold for precision paddle movement during serve pause or rallies.

spec.lose: The player loses the match when the CPU reaches seven points first, or when the time limit expires with the CPU ahead.
spec.scoring: Score 100 points whenever the player wins a rally point; first to seven points wins.
